title: Empirical restricted Fourier estimate run
statement: Let $n$, $m$, and $q$ be natural numbers, let $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, let $S\subseteq J$, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, fix three sequences $z,y,y'\in(\{−1,1\}^n)^m$, and fix a list $O$ of rational observations. The observation program followed by the specified finishing step returns the empirical restricted Fourier weight with denominator $q$, computed from the list obtained by appending the observations generated by the batch program to $O$, with probability one. Its cost is $\bigl(0,2m,m(2+2n+2|S|+1)+(q+1)\bigr)$.
hypotheses_covered: Three specified sequences of $m$ cube inputs
A specified list of rational observations
